about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The AryaBamboo story
about.p1: AryaBamboo is a brand that combines bamboo — nature's most renewable resource — with artisan craftsmanship. Our mission is to bring aesthetic, sustainable products into your daily life.
about.p2: In our workshop, every product is made one by one by skilled artisans. We support a natural lifestyle as an alternative to plastic.
about.p3: Quality, naturality, and customer satisfaction are our core values. Join us on this journey.

kvkk.title: Personal Data Protection Notice (KVKK)
kvkk.intro: Under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK"), we inform you about how AryaBamboo processes your personal data.
kvkk.s1: Data controller: AryaBamboo. Address: Istanbul, Turkey. Contact: info@aryabamboo.com — Phone: +90 533 700 73 18
kvkk.s2: Identity data (name, surname), contact data (email, phone, address), order and transaction data (products, amount, order number), customer transaction history.
kvkk.s3: Receiving and delivering orders, managing payment processes (bank transfer), customer service and communication, fulfilling legal obligations, performance of the distance sales agreement.
kvkk.s4: Your personal data may only be transferred to authorized public institutions when legally required and to shipping companies for delivery. Your data is not transferred abroad.
kvkk.s5: Your data is collected electronically through our website order form, contact form, and account creation. Legal basis: KVKK Art. 5/2-c (establishment or performance of a contract) and Art. 5/2-f (legitimate interest).
kvkk.s6: Your personal data is retained for the period required by the processing purpose and applicable legal retention periods (10 years for commercial records), then deleted, destroyed, or anonymized.
kvkk.s7: Under KVKK Art. 11, you have the right to learn whether your data is processed, request information, learn the purpose and whether it is used accordingly, know third parties to whom data is transferred, request correction, and request deletion or destruction.
kvkk.s8: To exercise your rights, send a written request to info@aryabamboo.com. Your requests will be answered free of charge within 30 days at the latest.
